text:
maria: heads-up — kicking off a config-only rollout for routing/egress limits (cfg-20260322-3). starting canary at 5% in us-west-2 at 00:30 PST. changes: per-tenant egress 1MB/s -> 800KB/s, throttle TTL 30s -> 20s, tinybatch window 8ms -> 6ms. please ack before we let the deploy-bot start.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary cfg-20260322-3 -> 5% in us-west-2. rollout id rlt-6876543210. starting in 2m. Type `status rlt-6876543210` to follow.

devon: quick q — what's the automatic rollback threshold?

maria: auto-rollback if 95p latency increases >20% sustained for 5m OR error-rate >0.5% absolute. manual rollback plan: pin previous config cfg-20260315-9 (`/pin config cfg-20260315-9`) and then `/rollback rlt-6876543210`.

ops-sre: seeing a slight bump in queue depth for canary instances already (few requests piling at worker queue). holding at 5% while we watch kvcache hit rate and connection churn.

sasha: metrics snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/egress/canary?var=rl=rlt-6876543210 — kvcache hit rate down 3% in canary, 99p latency +12% (not yet at alert). attaching log sample:

```
[canary-01] 00:36:12 WARN request queued=12 handler=router shard=3
[canary-01] 00:36:13 INFO kvcache.hit=false key=something-xyz
```

jorge: can we add a short warmup to reduce cold-kv effects? propose warmup.tokens_multiplier=2 for first 10m to prepopulate caches for new routing shards.

maria: good call. i'll push a small patch to the config: `warmup: { multiplier: 2, duration: 10m }`. deploy-bot: apply warmup patch to rlt-6876543210 canary only.

deploy-bot: applied patch `warmup` to rollout rlt-6876543210; canary remains at 5%. continue monitoring.

devon: after warmup live for ~6m — 99p latency is down to +6% vs baseline, errors stable. recommend keep at 5% for another 20m, then promote to 20% if stable. Manual rollback still ready.

ops-sre: agree. extend warmup window to 25m total (10m->25m) and keep the canary pinned at 5% for now. if 99p crosses +25% or errors >0.5% we roll back immediately.

maria: extending warmup to 25m now. monitoring heatmap and tail percentiles. if all green after 25m, i'll schedule promotion to 20% over a 10m linear ramp.

devon: note for release notes — include that this was a config-only egress/tinybatch tweak to reduce unit cost on long-running sessions; mention warmup added to mitigate kvcache churn.

jorge: small ops ask — when you promote, can we keep a short overlap window where both configs are available for 5m so SRE can sweep logs for any tenant-specific regressions?

maria: yes — plan: promote to 20% with `overlap: 5m` then full cutover. i'll annotate rollout: `notes: overlap=5m, owner=maria, runbook=/runbooks/egress-config`

deploy-bot: canary stable at 5% for 25m. metrics: 99p +7%, errors 0.12%. promoting to 20% over 10m with 5m overlap window. rollout id rlt-6876543210 -> ramping to 20%.

ops-sre: ack. i'll do a sweep for tenant hot paths during ramp. ping me if anything spikes. :eyes:

sasha: ack. grabbing graphs.

maria: thanks team. if any automated rollback triggers fire, deploy-bot will pin and notify this thread. otherwise i'll post final release note after 1h stable. :shipit:
